rows.claim: The validator would fail on the missing input.
rows.evidence: The validator source (T0B3) lists 'inputs/tickets.csv' in INPUTS and prints FAIL (missing) and counts a failure when os.path.exists is false. The directory listing (T0B5) shows tickets.csv is absent from inputs/, so the validator would fail. The agent never ran the validator, but the code output shows this behavior.
